Apologies for the delay, we had planned to deliver this earlier but had been waiting after the Lenfi V2 vulnerability to see whether a relaunch date would be announced. As Lenfi V2 is still offline, we have proceeded with:
・Full Liqwid Finance integration (data indexing + transaction building)
・Lenfi V1 read - only integration (all loan data indexed)
・A working Yield Aggregator & Positions Dashboard UI

Deliverables attached
・High-Level Design PDF – architecture, data-flow, API/contract refs, and screenshots
・https://github.com/ADA-Markets/Docs/blob/main/Lending-Borrowing/High-Level-Design-v1-1.pdf 
・PNG of the high-level system diagram (embedded in the PDF)

As you will see in the doc above we are alot further along than just the design doc and have a platform with alot of the features already working on our dev environment so once this milestone is complete / approved we will submit milestone 2.
If anything is unclear or you’d like more details, please leave a comment and we’ll respond quickly.
Thanks for your time and support!

We are pleased to submit the final milestone for the Cardano Yield Hub a multi-protocol lending and borrowing aggregator for the Cardano ecosystem. The app is now fully functional and live:
🌐 Live app: https://yield.ada.markets
What’s Included
・Full integration of Surf Lending and Liqwid Finance
・Real-time protocol data: APYs, liquidity, TVL
・Wallet-connected position tracking and loan management
・Supply, borrow, repay flows across protocols
・Indexed read-only support for Fluid Tokens and Indigo Protocol
・DEX Aggregator integration

🎥 Close-Out Video 
 👉 https://youtu.be/hKOvSr7LJ-g 
📄 Final Close-Out Report:
 👉 https://github.com/ADA-Markets/Docs/blob/main/Lending-Borrowing/Final-Milestone-Lending-Aggregator.pdf 
Thank you to the Catalyst reviewers and community for the valuable time, guidance, and constructive feedback throughout this process.
All milestones are now complete, and the project stands as a fully functioning MVP, ready for continued adoption and future integrations.
Please let us know if any additional information is required.
Thank You
